veranderings.blok: Wat die stasie met die steenkool doen
veranderings.voor: kook water in sterk pype tot stoom
veranderings.na: kook water in sterk pype totdat dit stoom word
veranderings.rede: 'Water tot stoom kook' is a compressed, wooden construction; 'totdat dit stoom word' is the natural Afrikaans way to say the water boils until it becomes steam.

veranderings.blok: Nie elke stasie brand steenkool nie
veranderings.voor: kook ook water tot stoom wat 'n masjien laat draai
veranderings.na: kook ook water totdat dit stoom word, en die stoom laat 'n masjien draai
veranderings.rede: Same wooden 'kook tot stoom' construction as earlier in the lesson; splitting it into two clauses (with the AWS comma) also removes the ambiguous 'wat' that could refer to the water.
A definition opening with a bare 'Dit' reads stiffly; 'Die ding waaruit' is clearer for Grade 5 and matches the lesson's own sentence 'Die bron is die ding waaruit die stasie sy energie kry'.
